requirement_summary: Logical access security over protected information assets
aws_mechanism: IAM password policy; S3 account public access block; EBS encryption by default; KMS with rotation
evidence_query: aws iam get-account-password-policy; aws s3control get-public-access-block --account-id <id>; aws ec2 get-ebs-encryption-by-default; aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <id>

requirement_summary: Register and authorize users before issuing credentials; remove when no longer authorized
aws_mechanism: IAM Access Analyzer unused-access findings; IAM credential report
evidence_query: aws accessanalyzer list-findings-v2 --analyzer-arn <arn>; aws iam generate-credential-report && aws iam get-credential-report

requirement_summary: Authorize, modify, remove access based on roles; least privilege
aws_mechanism: Access Analyzer external and unused access analyzers; Security Hub IAM controls

requirement_summary: Protect against threats from outside the system boundary
aws_mechanism: GuardDuty; Security Hub FSBP network controls; S3 public access block
evidence_query: aws guardduty list-detectors; aws guardduty get-findings-statistics --detector-id <id> --finding-statistic-types COUNT_BY_SEVERITY

requirement_summary: Protect information during transmission and removal
aws_mechanism: TLS-only bucket policies (aws:SecureTransport); KMS encryption; Security Hub transport controls
evidence_query: aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket <audit-bucket>; aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket <audit-bucket>

requirement_summary: Prevent or detect unauthorized or malicious software
aws_mechanism: GuardDuty malware protection and runtime findings; ECR scan on push

requirement_summary: Detect configuration changes that introduce vulnerabilities
aws_mechanism: AWS Config recorder and conformance packs; Security Hub security checks
evidence_query: aws configservice describe-conformance-pack-compliance --conformance-pack-name <name>; aws securityhub get-compliance-summary (CSPM)

requirement_summary: Monitor components for anomalies indicating malicious acts or errors
aws_mechanism: CloudTrail to CloudWatch Logs; GuardDuty; Security Hub
evidence_query: aws cloudtrail get-trail-status --name <trail>; aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/cloudtrail

requirement_summary: Evaluate security events to determine whether they are incidents
aws_mechanism: Security Hub findings workflow (people process on top)

requirement_summary: Respond to incidents with a defined program
aws_mechanism: Process control: runbooks and tickets; CloudTrail evidence of actions taken

requirement_summary: Authorize, test, approve and implement changes
aws_mechanism: Pull request review and CI (Checkov) on every infrastructure change; Config change history

requirement_summary: Back-up processes and recovery infrastructure
aws_mechanism: AWS Backup plan and locked vault; KMS-encrypted recovery points
evidence_query: aws backup list-backup-jobs --by-state COMPLETED --by-created-after <date>; aws backup describe-backup-vault --backup-vault-name <vault>

requirement_summary: Test recovery plan procedures
aws_mechanism: Restore testing (AWS Backup restore testing plans) and documented drills

requirement_summary: Identify and maintain confidential information
aws_mechanism: Tagging of data stores; KMS keys per classification; macie optional

requirement_summary: Access control: allow access only to authorized persons or software programs
aws_mechanism: IAM with least privilege; Access Analyzer; Security Hub IAM controls

requirement_summary: Unique user identification (Required)
aws_mechanism: IAM users or Identity Center identities, no shared credentials; credential report
terraform_resource: Identity Center or IAM (out of module)

requirement_summary: Emergency access procedure (Required)
aws_mechanism: Break-glass role with CloudTrail alerting (process plus trail)

requirement_summary: Automatic logoff (Addressable)
aws_mechanism: Session duration limits on roles and Identity Center

requirement_summary: Encryption and decryption (Addressable)
aws_mechanism: KMS customer keys with rotation; EBS and S3 default encryption
evidence_query: aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <id>; aws ec2 get-ebs-encryption-by-default

requirement_summary: Audit controls: record and examine activity in systems containing ePHI
aws_mechanism: CloudTrail multi-region with log file validation, to KMS-encrypted S3 with Object Lock and CloudWatch Logs
evidence_query: aws cloudtrail validate-logs --trail-arn <arn> --start-time <date>; aws s3api get-object-lock-configuration --bucket <audit-bucket>

requirement_summary: Integrity: protect ePHI from improper alteration or destruction
aws_mechanism: Object Lock on audit data, backup vault lock, versioning

requirement_summary: Mechanism to authenticate ePHI (Addressable)
aws_mechanism: CloudTrail log file validation digests; S3 checksums

requirement_summary: Person or entity authentication
aws_mechanism: MFA enforcement via Identity Center or IAM policy; Security Hub IAM.4/IAM.5-style controls

requirement_summary: Transmission security over electronic networks
aws_mechanism: TLS-only policies; VPC endpoints; Security Hub transport controls

requirement_summary: Transmission encryption (Addressable)
aws_mechanism: TLS 1.2+ on load balancers and endpoints; Security Hub ELB controls
